page.content:
Inoki's fighting-spirit blend of catch, kicks, and martial-arts cred.

How Strong Style connects

  • Character: Antonio Inoki — Inoki built Strong Style as New Japan's fighting-spirit identity.
  • Topic: NJPW — Strong Style is the fighting-spirit identity of New Japan.

What is Strong Style?

Strong Style is New Japan's house aesthetic: stiff strikes, submissions, and the fighting-spirit ethos Inoki sold against pro-wrestling-as-entertainment.

Key threads lead to Antonio Inoki and NJPW.
